title: New computers don't speed up old code
summary: Matthias Wandel tests old and new code on a range of PCs, including a new mini PC, to measure how much faster modern hardware really is. He also shows optimization techniques such as branchless code, with benchmark programs on GitHub.
why: Used as evidence that CPU speed for branchy, dependent code has improved only modestly in 15-20 years, so software optimization matters.

quote.text: This great video [0] demonstrates how CPU performance has only increased 1.5-2x over the past 15(!) years when executing extremely branchy code.
